//: THE COMMODITY MARKET (docs/ECONOMY_MARKET.md stage A). One Reach-wide price a good, recomputed every turn from what the houses actually produced and consumed. `rules`: sharePct of production reaches the exchanges; the merchants hold coverYears of it in stock and drift relaxPct of the way back to that each year; short and long averages of demand and supply (shortPct, longPct of each year's reading) make the price react to CHANGE from the norm, so peace sits at base and a shock spikes and fades; easePct of the gap to the target price is closed a year; spreadPct between buy and sell at a market of your own or the capital, caravanSpreadPct otherwise; an order moves the price against itself by impactPct of its share of the stock; prices live between floorPct and capPct of base. `goods`: base credits a unit; sensitivity multiplies the pressure; warPct is the extra demand each war adds (four wars at most); minDemand damps the noise of a thin good; minStock is the least the merchants keep; buy/sell say which way a house may trade; `license` names a law effect of the Reach that must be in force to BUY (isotopes).
